crossRefs.note: Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love…
to keep Yahweh’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?
Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!
Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in…
that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

translations.web: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
translations.bsb: And what nation is great enough to have righteous statutes and ordinances like this entire law I set before you today?
translations.kjv: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
translations.asv: And what great nation is there, that hath statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
